Its case would be stronger with a direct grain-boundary-density control and defined oxygen potentials, and its assumption of a protective Al2O3-rich scale at only Al0.2 requires testing, but it is still more substantive and testable than A’s generic and less physically convincing Cr/Ti-scale explanation.
